text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Some time after the fiercely contested
U.A.F. Finals had concluded—

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
—Actually, the hosting of the second 'U.A.F.'
has officially been decided.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
You helped me out so much, Trainer,
so I really wanted to tell you directly!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Knowing that the U.A.F.—where I gained so much
invaluable experience—will continue forward
brings me immense personal joy...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Surely, <chrname>, having gained so much strength to face this race, felt the exact same way—

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
"We will continue to do our utmost to make the U.A.F.
into an entertainment spectacle on par with the Twinkle Series."

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Please let me support you from the shadows...
as you and <chrname> continue to achieve great things in the future.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
If you ever feel like competing again, <chrname>-san,
just say the word!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: When that time comes, it's gonna be an event overflowing with way, way more sparkle!

text_block_list.name: Academy Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey hey, did you catch Elfi's stream!?
Looks like they're doing 'U.A.F.' again!”

text_block_list.name: Academy Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Totally~! The Umamusume from our academy who competed last time did super well too.

text_block_list.name: Academy Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: "Apparently there are tons of experiences you can apply to races...!? Kind of makes you curious!"

text_block_list.name: Academy Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"Honestly, I just purely want to cheer for Elfi.
Last time was way more exciting than I ever thought it'd be."
choice_data_list: (So the "U.A.F." is really making waves, huh…)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The "U.A.F." will surely continue to bring out the brilliance of diverse athlete Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That conviction still burned brightly within my chest—
